title: Honey Garlic Chicken
description: Pan-seared chicken thighs in a sticky honey, garlic and soy glaze. A 25-minute weeknight dinner that works with rice or noodles.

image.alt: Glazed chicken thighs with sesame seeds and green onion, beside rice

steps.text: Pat the chicken dry and season with the salt and pepper.

Heat the oil in the skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken until golden, {time 5-6 min}, then flip and cook until it reaches {temp 175F internal}, {time 5 min}. Move to a plate and pour off most of the fat.
Lower the heat to medium, add the butter and garlic and stir until fragrant, {time 30 sec}.
Add the honey, soy sauce and vinegar and simmer, stirring, until slightly thickened and bubbly, {time 2 min}.
Return the chicken and turn it in the sauce until glazed, {time 1-2 min}. Scatter with green onions and serve.

notes: The glaze thickens quickly as it cools; add a splash of water if it gets too sticky.
